notes: The pillow care label and fill material control. Do not assume every pillow is machine washable: memory foam and specialty fills may require different care. For machine-washable pillows, use a balanced load and a gentle/bedding-appropriate cycle consistent with the washer manual and care label. Drying instructions must follow the label, and the pillow should be fully dry before use to avoid trapped moisture.
